official_overall_design_area_sqm.formula: official announcement value: 11.4 km2 converted to sqm

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official floor-area inputs are not present in the public cleared site package.

building_density.formula: building_footprint_area_sqm / official_site_area_sqm after official boundary confirmation
building_density.reason: The scaffold footprint is conceptual and the official statutory site boundary is not published.

noon_sla_corridor_count.formula: count(SLA-A/SLA-B/SLA-C service path types organized across the current multi-segment route network and drawing layer; not equal to the number of road-centerline features)

noon_service_node_count.formula: count(features with node_id in geometry/public_space.geojson; excludes secondary support_point_id features; primary nodes are concept points placed by endpoint, turning, staying, crossing, public-entry, and heat/rain-risk siting rules)

human_fallback_node_count.formula: count(features with fallback_id in geometry/public_space.geojson; fallback points are selected from the service-node network at section transitions, transit access, key public entries, crossings, and event-flow convergence points)

industry_validation_scenario_count.formula: count(IV-01..IV-03 explicitly bounded in proposal.md#13.3 and proposal.en.md#13.3)

pilgrimage_node_count.formula: count(H-01..H-04 conceptual interpretation/honour-display nodes in proposal.md#13.5 and proposal.en.md#13.5; not existing heritage or official awards)

field_verification_task_count.formula: count(tasks deterministically derived from existing Noonline SLA route conditions and evidence gaps)
field_verification_task_count.reason: This counts verification tasks, not observed facilities or verified field evidence.

sla_a_mandatory_verification_task_count.reason: Mandatory evidence-gate task count; it does not state that any condition is field verified.

field_verification_unknown_task_count.formula: count(tasks where status=unknown in the generated baseline ledger)
field_verification_unknown_task_count.reason: This reports the workflow baseline. It is not a count of physical failures or facilities.

geometry_service_node_on_declared_line_r.formula: count(service_node Point with 0 m distance to one declared linked LineString) / count(service_node Point) = 12 / 12; geometric relation only
geometry_service_node_on_declared_line_r.reason: This verifies coordinate association in the concept network. It does not verify public access, walking continuity or an existing facility.

geometry_route_node_spacing_max_m.formula: maximum network distance between adjacent primary service nodes along the explicit concept LineString graph, including Level 1 service zones and Level 2 inter-zone connectors
geometry_route_node_spacing_max_m.reason: This full-corridor primary-node diagnostic includes Level 2 connectors. The 4,298.796 m N05-to-N09 gap is an inter-zone connector, not a Level 1 SLA-service-zone coverage claim. Its equal straight-line and concept-network lengths result from the submitted collinear LineStrings, not a surveyed pedestrian route.

geometry_route_node_spacing_median_m.formula: median network distance of the 11 adjacent primary-service-node gaps along the explicit full concept LineString graph, including Level 2 inter-zone connectors
geometry_route_node_spacing_median_m.reason: This full-corridor diagnostic is not a measured walking or accessible distance and is not used to assess the Level 1 <=400 m design target.

geometry_primary_corridor_adjacent_gap_c.formula: count(adjacent primary service-node gaps along the explicit full concept LineString graph; secondary support points excluded)

gap_table.relationship: AI Origin to Dazhongsi Level 2 inter-zone connector
AI Origin to Zhongzhiyuan Level 2 inter-zone connector
Zhongzhiyuan Level 1 service-zone spine; secondary supports inserted separately
AI Origin Level 1 service-zone spine; secondary support inserted separately
Dazhongsi Level 1 transit connector; secondary support inserted separately
AI Origin Level 1 lateral connector; secondary support inserted separately
Zhongzhiyuan Level 1 research-test interface; secondary support inserted separately
Zhongzhiyuan Level 1 public-entry interface; secondary support inserted separately

geometry_primary_corridor_adjacent_gap_c.reason: The table documents primary-node distribution only. It does not claim an existing legal, accessible or field-verified walking network.

level1_sla_service_zone_count.formula: count(key areas with LEVEL_1_SLA_SERVICE_ZONE route features: Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin, Dazhongsi)
level1_sla_service_zone_count.reason: Service-zone extents follow provisional concept geometry, not official area boundaries.

level2_inter_zone_connector_count.formula: count(LineString features with service_network_level=LEVEL_2_INTER_ZONE_CONNECTOR: ROAD-001 and ROAD-003)
level2_inter_zone_connector_count.reason: Level 2 carries concept corridor continuity, route recognition, cultural sequence and AI-OFF wayfinding; it does not claim <=400 m service-point continuity.

secondary_support_point_count.formula: count(features with support_point_id; excludes primary node_id and fallback_id features)
secondary_support_point_count.reason: These are non-staffed concept support points for fixed wayfinding and future shade/rest reservation, not existing seats, water, entries or staffed service.

level1_support_spacing_max_m.formula: maximum network distance between adjacent primary node_id or secondary support_point_id features on explicit LEVEL_1_SLA_SERVICE_ZONE LineStrings
level1_support_spacing_max_m.reason: A geometry-derived concept-network result only. It proves neither public access nor installed shade, seats, water, entries, crossings, staffing or accessible walking continuity.

level1_support_spacing_median_m.formula: median network distance of 17 adjacent primary node_id or secondary support_point_id gaps on explicit LEVEL_1_SLA_SERVICE_ZONE LineStrings
level1_support_spacing_median_m.reason: A geometry-derived concept-network result only; field walking and accessible distances require verification.

level1_support_spacing_over_400_count.formula: count(adjacent primary node_id or secondary support_point_id network gaps greater than 400 m on explicit LEVEL_1_SLA_SERVICE_ZONE LineStrings)
level1_support_spacing_over_400_count.reason: This is a concept-geometry target check. It does not certify field service coverage or Verified SLA.

design_target_service_node_spacing_m.formula: participant-declared <=400 m concept spacing target between adjacent primary node_id or secondary support_point_id features on explicit Level 1 SLA service-zone LineStrings only; not an official standard or existing-condition measurement
design_target_service_node_spacing_m.reason: Current concept geometry meets this target only inside the three Level 1 service zones. It does not apply to Level 2 inter-zone connectors and does not prove legal, continuous or accessible field routes.

design_target_seat_water_service_distanc.formula: participant-declared concept design target for walking service distance to seating and drinking-water provision; not an official standard or existing facility inventory
design_target_seat_water_service_distanc.reason: This is a future implementation target within Level 1 service zones. Secondary support points do not provide, prove or count as seats or water; location, availability and access remain field-verification tasks.

design_target_max_continuous_exposure_m.formula: participant-declared maximum continuous exposed-walking design target for a deliverable midday path; not a measured shade result or official standard
design_target_max_continuous_exposure_m.reason: No tree canopy, building-shadow or summer field dataset is available to calculate current exposure.

design_target_staffed_fallback_per_key_a.formula: participant-declared minimum concept target of one staffed fallback role per key area, with additional roles at complex transfer points; not confirmed staffing availability
design_target_staffed_fallback_per_key_a.reason: The five fallback points are concept locations only. Responsible actors and service hours remain unverified.

field_verified_shade_continuity_ratio.formula: field-verified shaded route length / field-verified legal route length during the approved midday condition
field_verified_shade_continuity_ratio.reason: No field-verified canopy, shadow, legal route or midday observation data is present in the baseline ledger.

field_verified_max_continuous_exposure_m.formula: maximum measured continuous exposed distance along a field-verified legal route during the approved midday condition
field_verified_max_continuous_exposure_m.reason: No field measurement of continuous exposure exists in the submission.

field_verified_accessible_detour_m.formula: measured accessible alternative route length minus measured direct legal route length, after field verification
field_verified_accessible_detour_m.reason: Curb, ramp, lift, legal crossing and public-entry conditions have not been field verified; straight-line geometry is not an accessible-detour proxy.

field_verified_public_entry_opening_rati.formula: count(field-verified public entries open in approved service window) / count(declared required public entries)
field_verified_public_entry_opening_rati.reason: No timestamped public-entry opening and accessibility observations are present.

implementation_work_package_count.reason: Six reversible packages are each linked to a spatial reference, concept role, resource band, verification gate and stop response. This is a delivery-control count, not a construction commitment.

implementation_concept_role_count.reason: The roles are not appointed entities. They identify the capability that must be named before a phase or component can advance.

implementation_resource_band_count.reason: RB-1, RB-2 and RB-3 describe capability and review depth. They are explicitly not financial estimates or procurement packages.

implementation_stoppable_risk_count.formula: count(risks with a trigger, control and verification path in the implementation-control register)
implementation_stoppable_risk_count.reason: The register makes public access, accessibility, heat, maintenance, test safety, AI exclusion and provisional-boundary misrepresentation explicit stop or downgrade conditions.

v4_core_figure_count.reason: The count records authored presentation figures. It does not add spatial objects or evidence.

site_evidence_ladder_level_count.formula: count(Level A publicly supported, Level B design inference, Level C field verification required, Level D professional study required)
site_evidence_ladder_level_count.reason: The ladder is a claim-control method, not a score or a replacement for survey.
